name: Erion's Behest
summary: Across the Great Sea, Erion's Behest carries a summons to promising night elf rogues in Darnassus. Erion Shadewhisper sees their growing skill in stealth and sends them to Stormwind City to report to Stormwind Intelligence.

sections.title: A Summons Across the Sea
sections.body: Night elf rogues in Teldrassil's shadow train under mentors such as Erion Shadewhisper. When one shows exceptional talent, word reaches beyond the World Tree. Through Erion, Stormwind Intelligence, known as SI:7, invites the rogue across the Great Sea to the human capital.

sections.title: Entering the Service of SI:7
sections.body: The journey leads from northern Kalimdor through the docks of Darkshore or the Wetlands to Stormwind City. In the capital, you make your way to SI:7 headquarters in Old Town and report to Renzik "The Shiv." He assesses newcomers and opens the way to advanced espionage, poison mastery, and covert operations for the Alliance.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Erion Shadewhisper, the rogue trainer in Darnassus, sends you after your early deeds draw the attention of intelligence networks across the sea.

faq.q: Why is Stormwind Intelligence contacting a night elf?
faq.answer: The Alliance relies on SI:7 to coordinate covert intelligence and sabotage, alongside the night elves' own stealth traditions. Stormwind Intelligence seeks capable rogues of every Alliance race for its ranks.

faq.q: Where do I find Renzik 'The Shiv'?
faq.answer: Renzik "The Shiv" is inside SI:7 headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town.

faq.q: Is this quest only for rogues?
faq.answer: Yes. This Alliance rogue assignment guides operatives from Kalimdor to Stormwind, the center of Alliance intelligence training.
Reporting to Renzik brings you into SI:7's training operations in the Eastern Kingdoms, where specialized training and covert assignments await throughout the human lands.

faq.q: How does a night elf get to Stormwind City at this stage?
faq.answer: You can sail from Auberdine in Darkshore straight across the sea to Stormwind Harbor.

angles.text: As a rogue, you leave local Kalimdor scuffles for continental espionage and lethal training under SI:7.
As a night elf, leaving Darnassus and Teldrassil to serve human intelligence in Stormwind's stone alleys can bring a sharp culture shock.
As an Alliance member, you can see SI:7 gather covert operations and deploy talented scouts from every member race where the crown needs them.
